purpose: Supplement existing native Ad Orientem 1962 processional readers with historically labelled Solesmes chant/movement witnesses. No new reader, calendar, chant authority or release eligibility is created.

sourceEditions.title: Processionale monasticum ad usum congregationis Gallicae Ordinis S. Benedicti
sourceEditions.warning: Do not assign 1893 page references, chants or movements to this 1888 edition without an image/page collation.

sourceEditions.title: Processionale monasticum ad usum congregationis Gallicae Ordinis sancti Benedicti
sourceEditions.warning: OCR syllabification and characters are unreliable; printed facsimile must be checked before text/notation export.

sourceEditions.title: Solesmes facsimile reprint of 1893 with omissions

guardrails.rights: Original 1888/1893 texts may be old enough for public domain, but modern editions and scan-file redistribution must be assessed independently.

evidence.heading: De ritu Processionum
evidence.finding: Processional ceremonial rubrics have a distinct section.
evidence.followup: Facsimile review for participants, pauses and spatial actions.

evidence.heading: Ad Aspersionem aquae benedictae; Preces in locis regularibus aspergendis
evidence.finding: Aspersion and blessing of monastic regular places are indexed separately.
evidence.followup: Do not merge monastic regular-place aspersion into the Roman Asperges reader.

evidence.heading: Dominica in Palmis
evidence.finding: Antiphons accompany distribution of palms before the procession.
evidence.followup: Compare order, variants and 1955/1962 reform with current Roman Palm source before any runtime change.

evidence.heading: Dominica in Palmis — processio
evidence.finding: A dialogue separates distribution from the outgoing procession; further antiphons continue while the procession lasts.
evidence.followup: Compare stage boundaries and ending with 1962 Palm Sunday; never assume pre-1955 ceremonial identity.

evidence.heading: Litaniae majores et minores
evidence.followup: Collate petitions, repetitions and procession/Mass handoff against 1962 Rogations source; preserve nonduplicated 1962 petitions.

evidence.heading: In festo Corporis Christi
evidence.finding: The historical book starts Pange lingua at the priest's departure from the altar; full six-stanza hymn is printed.
evidence.followup: Compare with existing 1962 source and current trigger MONSTRANCE_PLACED_IN_CELEBRANT_HANDS; this historical text does not settle that trigger.

evidence.heading: Dominical processional seasonal repertoire
evidence.finding: Sunday/seasonal procession chants indexed for Advent, Septuagesima, Lent and Sundays per annum.
evidence.followup: Catalog as Benedictine history only; do not make weekly processions automatic in calendar.

evidence.heading: In Purificatione B. Mariae Virginis
evidence.finding: Lumen ad revelationem with repeated antiphon is used during candle distribution.
evidence.followup: Compare with CND-R03 distribution refrain/verses and current authoritative 1962 source.

evidence.heading: In Purificatione — processio
evidence.finding: Departure dialogue and procession follow candle distribution; printed chants mark movement and return.
evidence.followup: Review existing CND-R05 and CND-R06 stage cues against authoritative Roman books.

evidence.heading: Processiones pro variis necessitatibus
evidence.finding: Special processions indexed for rain, fair weather, storm, famine, pestilence, war and thanksgiving.
evidence.followup: Historical classification only; no automatic civil/weather/calendar triggers.

evidence.heading: Appendix pro monasterio S. Petri de Solesmis
incipits: Domine Jesu Christe, seminator casti consilii
evidence.finding: Station antiphons for St Mary, St Cecilia, St Aquilinus and St Peter are attached to particular Solesmes Rogation destinations, including directions through its grounds.
evidence.followup: Do not import these local stations or specific routes into the universal Rogations or generic procession readers.

crosswalk.gap: Distribution-to-procession transition and order; 1893 monastic vs 1962 Roman differences unresolved.
Chant/text change points during distribution, outgoing procession and return.
Pange opening trigger requires contemporary authoritative confirmation; no change to the native controller.
Solesmes station-specific materials explicitly excluded from universal text; 1962 single-petition behavior remains.
Existing generic reader is structural and has a SOURCE_HOLD; no feast or need-specific text until a dedicated verified proper exists.
Do not equate asperges in monastery rooms with pre-Mass Asperges/Vidi aquam.

roman1962Contrasts.actualMainline: src/mass/reader-palm.js PALM-R02 distribution, PALM-R03 Gospel, PALM-R04 procession.
roman1962Contrasts.finding: 1962 Gospel comes after distribution and before proceeding; native reader already preserves that order.
